unit.title: Debug Labs — типичные ошибки событийной игры

learning_outcomes.statement: Collects seventeen typical event-driven-game bugs as a symptom-to-fix reference, covering focus, closures, check ordering, model/view confusion, reset semantics, blocking animation and duplicated bindings.

findings.description: F-012: Debug Lab 16's symptom line was ungrammatical ('на весь почти секунду') and understated the freeze -- range(6) with two sleep(0.15) calls is 1.8 s, not 'почти секунду'.
findings.resolution: Rewrote the line as 'Окно перестаёт отвечать почти на две секунды анимации —', fixing both the grammar and the arithmetic.

evidence.summary: Learning objective and scope: Collects seventeen typical event-driven-game bugs as a symptom-to-fix reference, covering focus, closures, check ordering, model/view confusion, reset semantics, blocking animation and duplicated bindings.

Debug Lab 1: an Entry-level handler returning 'break' stops a key event before it reaches root's binding, and without that 'break' the event would continue to root. -- confirmed exactly -- with a 'break' handler the root binding gets nothing and the Entry stays empty; without it the root binding fires and the character is inserted. Both halves of the explanation are correct.
Debug Lab 2: without i=indeks all nine closures share the loop variable and act on index 8. -- confirmed -- reproduced with three buttons yielding [2,2,2].

Debug Lab 5: checking all(board) before find_winner reports a draw on a ninth move that wins. -- confirmed -- notebook 17-29 reproduces it: status_broken(...) returns 'Ничья!' where the fixed order returns 'Победил игрок X!'.

Debug Lab 16: time.sleep in the win animation freezes the window for 'почти секунду'. -- PARTIALLY REFUTED as found -- the blocking claim is correct (time.sleep blocks the event loop), but the arithmetic was wrong: the shown loop is range(6) with two sleep(0.15) calls per iteration = 1.8 s. The symptom line was also ungrammatical. Fixed under F-012.

Debug Lab 17: bind(..., add='+') on a button that already has command= runs the logic twice for one click. -- confirmed -- add='+' appends rather than replaces (verified: ['second','third']), so a duplicate path fires twice.
